item.title: Before Blaming AI False Positives: The Security Debt of Generalist-Led Organizations
item.description: A Korean financial-sector AI code-analysis test reported 40–60% false positives. The deeper question is how technical expertise, validation workflows, budgets, and decision rights shape actual security outcomes.
